scope: QuartzDriver follow plus ActorSwing springs, captured dynamic/static colliders, and inferred skirt/jacket rings. Collider offsets are baked from Unity rest into PMX/THREE local space when rest+skeleton are supplied. Dynamic collider masks/radii come from the captured NativeList when supplied; game assemblies are not executed.

quartzStageAdaptation.formulaSource: serialized Quartz settings; capture job IO was not executed

stageAdaptationNotes.skirtTerminalParticleRadius: Restore each Skirt4_S_End captured 0.04 m radius for leg contact at the visible hem joint (owned by Skirt3_S) and at the terminal spring. The native around-chain is bound through named child particles, so Skirt3_S and Skirt4_S_End use their Unity bone positions instead of the owning spring tail and fake terminal continuation. The front root and second skirt segments also use their captured child radius so the front cloth rests on the thigh capsule; side and back upper segments retain their prior shell settings.
